N: <int> Number of retailer locations in the distribution network.
retailer_locations: <list[list[float]], shape [N][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates of each retailer on a planar grid.

first_stage.variable_lower_bounds: <list[float], length N> Minimum allowable order-up-to stock level for each retailer.

second_stage.holding_costs: <list[float], length N> Per-unit cost of holding unsold inventory at each retailer after demand is observed.
second_stage.penalty_costs: <list[float], length N> Per-unit cost of unmet demand (backlog) at each retailer after demand is observed.
second_stage.transshipment_costs_mean: <list[list[float]], shape [N][N]> Average per-unit cost of shipping goods from one retailer to another, with zero on the diagonal.
second_stage.transshipment_costs_std: <list[list[float]], shape [N][N]> Standard deviation of the per-unit transshipment cost for each directed retailer pair, nonzero only for links subject to cost uncertainty.
second_stage.random_cost_links: <list[list[int]], length varies, each element length 2> Directed retailer pairs whose transshipment costs are uncertain, given as zero-indexed origin-destination pairs.
second_stage.random_cost_std_fraction: <float> Ratio of the standard deviation to the mean for transshipment costs on links subject to cost uncertainty.
second_stage.mean_demands: <list[float], length N> Expected customer demand at each retailer location.

demand_distribution.scenarios: <list[list[float]], shape [num_scenarios][N]> Realized customer demand at each retailer under each scenario.
demand_distribution.probabilities: <list[float], length num_scenarios> Probability of each demand scenario occurring.
